name: passive fatality
source:
Do you remember yourself?

You wake up in the middle of nowhere, unable to even remember your own name. 

Go through files containing your memories and piece together what happened to you. With each memory, you get closer to uncovering the truth...but it may be harder than you thought.

Do you want to remember yourself?

[From [url=https://ever-squish.itch.io/passive-fatality]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你还记得自己是谁吗？

你在荒无人烟之地醒来，甚至连自己的名字都想不起来。

翻阅装满你过往记忆的档案，一点点拼凑出自己身上究竟发生过什么。每找回一段记忆，你便离揭开真相更近一步……但这一切或许远比你想象的更加艰难。

你真的想要想起自己吗？

[摘自[url=https://ever-squish.itch.io/passive-fatality]itch.io[/url]]
